translations.web: That which is crooked can’t be made straight; and that which is lacking can’t be counted.
translations.bsb: What is crooked cannot be straightened, and what is lacking cannot be counted.
translations.kjv: That which is crooked cannot be made straight: and that which is wanting cannot be numbered.
translations.asv: That which is crooked cannot be made straight; and that which is wanting cannot be numbered.
